en.title: Longest Alternating Substring After At Most k Single-Character Flips
en.description:
In a binary string you may flip one character at a time, at most k times. Find the maximum length of a contiguous substring in which every pair of adjacent characters differs. It is a substring, not a subsequence, and flips apply to single characters, not to whole ranges.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains the binary string; the second line contains k. The original text gave no numeric bounds; this site uses 1≤length≤200000, 0≤k≤200000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
hints: Match against the global templates 0101… and 1010… separately, with a sliding window that keeps the number of mismatched positions within k.
